headline_marked: 2 police injured as [[banned Chhatra League and Jubo League activists attack]] police car in Gopalganj
headline: 2 police injured as banned Chhatra League and Jubo League activists attack police car in Gopalganj
summary: Activists from the banned organizations attacked a police patrol car with sticks and indigenous weapons after being stopped from holding a procession.
details: Two police officers were injured when activists from the banned Chhatra League and Jubo League attacked a police patrol car in the Raghunathpur area of Gopalganj Sadar upazila.
The incident occurred around 3:00 PM on Saturday (October 24) in the Burimar Gachtala area.
According to police, a patrol team stopped a procession of the banned organizations' leaders and activists, leading to the group to attack the vehicle with sticks and indigenous weapons.
Gopalganj Sadar Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Md. Aminul Islam confirmed the event and stated that police are currently conducting operations to arrest the attackers.

headline_marked: Unknown assailants [[fire shots at singer Asif Akbar's car]] in Dhaka
headline: Unknown assailants fire shots at singer Asif Akbar's car in Dhaka
summary: The singer escaped unharmed as he was not inside the vehicle when the shooting took place in Moghbazar early today.
details: Unknown assailants opened fire at the private car of singer Asif Akbar in Dhaka’s Moghbazar area early today.
The incident occurred around 4:00 am in front of the Bishal Centre, where Asif had parked his car.
According to Saiful Islam, inspector (operations) of Hatirjheel Police Station, Asif was not inside the vehicle during the attack and escaped unharmed.
Asif informed the police about the incident around 5:00 am, after which police visited the scene to investigate.
Investigators were unable to collect CCTV footage immediately because the shops in the market were closed at the time.
Police stated that they will collect the footage once the shops open and will take further action based on their findings.
